title: AutoCAD Civil 3D Corridor Model
subtitle: Route geometry, cross-section design and existing terrain are combined into a corridor whose regions drive sections and quantities

parts.label: Alignment
parts.detail: Horizontal plan geometry -> fixes the route path and stationing the corridor follows

parts.label: Profile
parts.detail: Vertical design grade -> sets the finished-surface elevation at each station

parts.label: Subassembly
parts.detail: One parametric element (pavement, gutter, shoulder) -> sizes a slice of the section

parts.label: Assembly
parts.detail: Ordered set of subassemblies -> combines them into the full design cross-section template

parts.label: Surface
parts.detail: Existing-terrain TIN -> supplies ground elevations used for cut, fill and section checking

parts.label: Corridor
parts.detail: Alignment + profile + assembly + surface -> builds the 3D model of the road along the route

parts.label: Corridor region
parts.detail: Stretches where one assembly applies -> the corridor splits where the assembly changes

parts.label: Sections
parts.detail: Sampled at design stations from corridor + surface -> verify design against ground

parts.label: Quantity takeoff
parts.detail: Cut, fill, areas and volumes from corridor surfaces and sections -> feeds construction quantities

takeaway: Geometry, section design and terrain become a corridor; its regions carry the design down to checked sections and construction quantities
